pr_body:
Fix auth blocking runtime

I have decided to remove async code from `meilisearch-auth` and let `meilisearch-http` handle that.

Because Actix polls the extractor futures concurrently, I have made a wrapper extractor that forces the errors from the futures to be returned sequentially (though is still polls them sequentially).
close #2201

issue_context.title: Blocking calls in authentication extractor
issue_context.body:
Reviewing the auth implementation, I found that blocking calls to heed were performed in the implementation of the extractor.


- [blocking calls](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/blob/main/meilisearch-auth/src/lib.rs#L54-L58) are made in async contexts.
- [`FromRequest`](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/blob/main/meilisearch-http/src/extractors/authentication/mod.rs#L37) should not return a `Ready` future, but a custom future, encapsulating the authentication action. a boxed future should do the trick, but it should be possible to do it more elegantly.

review_comments: Maybe you can put this allow non_snake_case on the struct instead?
not possible, you also get the lint when referring to those fields, it needs to be a module level lint here
I don't understand why we don't let the `async fn` in `meilisearch-auth`, this would avoid this wrapping, no?
async auth does not actually do anything related to async, so it made more sense to move te boundary over to meilisearch-http
OOOOOKKK... My bad, I misunderstood the behavior of `async`, thanks!
